I am a postdoctoral scholar in the Department of Public Health Sciences at the Medical University of South Carolina, working with [Dr. Souvik Seal](https://sealx017.github.io/). I develop statistical methods for single-cell and spatial omics, with a focus on biomarker discovery and replicate-aware multi-sample analysis, building on a background in scalable Bayesian methods for spatial data.

I received my Ph.D. in Statistics from Texas A&M University (2024), advised by [Dr. Matthias Katzfuss](https://sites.google.com/view/katzfuss/home).

### Research interests
- Biomarker discovery in single-cell and spatial omics
- Multi-sample spatial omics and spatially aware dimension reduction
- Scalable Gaussian processes and Bayesian computation
